# Separate balk runner attribution

An explicitly joined operative balk shares one judgment and decision across its awarded runners, separate from the later PA result.

This view shows the ontology pattern without MLB JSON paths or RML machinery.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    N01["Balk Rule"]
    N02["Baseball Decision ICE"]
    N03["Umpire Judgment Act"]
    N04["Plate Appearance"]
    N05["Balk Process"]
    N06["Steal Attempt Act"]
    N07["Baseball Event Record"]
    N02 -->|is about| N05
    N03 -->|has input| N01
    N03 -->|has output| N02
    N03 -->|occurrent part of| N05
    N05 -->|has occurrent part| N03
    N05 -->|occurrent part of| N04
    N05 -->|prescribed by| N01
    N07 -->|is about| N02
    N07 -->|is about| N03
    N07 -->|is about| N05
    N07 -->|is about| N06
```
